Analyst Call Recording 
 
Pursuant to Regulation 46(2)(oa) of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) 
Regulations, 2015, as amended, we hereby inform the exchanges that the audio call recording of the 
Company’s Analyst Call to discuss the Audited Financial Results (Consolidated and Standalone) of the
